basic_identification.full_title: Flexible Conductors for Carbon Brushes — Specification (कार्बन ब्रशों के लिए सन्मय चालकों की विशिष्टि)
basic_identification.sector_category: Electrotechnical / Rotating Machinery (finalized by the Rotating Machinery Sectional Committee, ET 15, of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

scope.summary: This Indian Standard prescribes the material specifications, design configurations, stranding patterns, wire diameters, and performance criteria for flexible copper conductors (shunts/pigtails) embedded in or attached to carbon brushes of rotating electrical machines.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Material Specification (Electrotechnical Department / Rotating Machinery)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary Product Specification. Manufacturers are highly encouraged to obtain a valid BIS license to stamp or etch the physical ISI 'Standard Mark' directly on the product packaging to demonstrate mechanical and metallurgical conformity in electrical rotating machines.

requirements.detail: Observed or calculated final test values, individual wire diameters, and bundle counts must be rounded off mathematically in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.
Conductors must be fabricated from high-purity, high-conductivity annealed copper wires (plain or tinned) to minimize electrical resistance and avoid heat buildup.
Individual wires utilized to build flexible bunches must have standardized micro-diameters of either 0.05 mm, 0.07 mm, 0.10 mm, or 0.12 mm.
Establishes a precise, flexibility-driven strand system defined by B (wire bunches per strand) and W (wires per bunch) to resist mechanical fatigue.
The joint between the flexible conductor and the carbon brush must withstand strict tension pull tests to ensure it does not detach under severe dynamic vibration during motor operation.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 13525 : 1992 (Reaffirmed 2003) is the primary national Indian Standard specification prescribing construction, material, and dimensional requirements for flexible copper conductors (shunts/pigtails) used with carbon brushes in rotating electrical machines. Maintained under the Rotating Machinery Sectional Committee (ET 15), the code unifies the manufacturing of flexible brush shunts. It mandates high-purity annealed copper wire with standardized micro-diameters (0.05 to 0.12 mm) and specifies precise bunching configurations (combining wire bunches per strand) to ensure maximum flexibility and resistance to vibration-induced wire fatigue.
